lines.text: The Benjamites failed to drive out the Jebusites living in Jerusalem.
The house of Joseph attacked Bethel, and the man who showed them the entrance went to the land of the Hittites.
Manasseh failed to drive out the inhabitants of Beth-shean, Taanach, Dor, Ibleam, and Jericho.
The Amorites forced the Danites into the hill country and did not allow them to come down into the plain.
The angel of the LORD went up from Shiloh to Bochim, and the people wept and offered sacrifices there.
